What "Seasoned" Firewood Actually Means

Freshly cut ("green") wood can hold 40% or more moisture, which makes it hard to light, smoky, and inefficient — most of the heat goes into boiling off water instead of warming the room. Properly seasoned firewood is dried until its moisture content drops well below 20%, which usually takes six months to a year of open-air drying for dense hardwoods. Roubic splits and stacks its cordwood at the Auburn Township yard so it seasons before it reaches your Pepper Pike home.

A full cord is a stacked stack measuring 4 ft × 4 ft × 8 ft (128 cubic feet). "Face cords" and partial loads are a fraction of that — worth confirming when you compare quotes, since a "cord" from different sellers isn't always the same volume.

Why Order Ahead

The Cost of Waiting — Pepper Pike Context

Three reasons Pepper Pike homeowners order firewood early instead of in the first cold snap.

Green Wood Won't Burn Right

Order at the last minute and you may be stuck buying whatever's available — often under-seasoned wood that smokes, hisses, and throws little heat. Ordering ahead lets you burn properly dried hardwood.

Peak-Season Demand

Once the first hard freeze hits, everyone calls at once. Delivery windows stretch and good seasoned stock moves fast. Booking early in the fall locks in your load and your schedule.

Running Out Mid-Winter

Underbuying means a scramble in January when supply is tightest. A right-sized cord or a bulk load ordered up front carries you through the season without the mid-winter panic run.

Common Pepper Pike Firewood Questions

Pepper Pike Firewood Delivery FAQ

Six things Pepper Pike homeowners want to know before ordering firewood.

What kind of firewood does Roubic deliver in Pepper Pike?
Roubic delivers split mixed hardwood — mostly oak, maple, ash, and cherry — cut from the tree removals and prunings our crews already do across Northeast Ohio. These are dense hardwoods that hold heat well through an Ohio winter, split and stacked at our Auburn Township yard.
How much does firewood cost in Pepper Pike?
Cordwood runs $180–$450 per cord depending on the wood mix, the quantity you order, and delivery distance. Partial (face) cords and multi-cord bulk loads are quoted per order, and stacking can be added on-site. Call for current stock and a firm Pepper Pike delivery quote.
What exactly is a cord of firewood?
A full cord is a stacked pile measuring 4 ft × 4 ft × 8 ft — 128 cubic feet of wood. A "face cord" or partial load is a fraction of that. Because sellers don't always use the term the same way, it's worth confirming the actual volume when you compare firewood quotes.
Is the firewood seasoned and ready to burn?
Our hardwood is split and seasoned at the yard so it dries below the roughly 20% moisture level that wood needs to light easily and burn cleanly, rather than going out green off the truck. Because stock and drying time vary through the season, ask about current moisture and availability when you order.
Do you deliver and stack firewood in Pepper Pike?
Yes. Firewood is delivered straight to your driveway, and our crew can stack it where you want it as an add-on. Pepper Pike is one of our five Tier 1 cities, so orders get priority scheduling.
How fast can you deliver firewood in Pepper Pike?
Pepper Pike sits about ten minutes from our Auburn Township yard, so most firewood orders are delivered within a few days of your call. Demand climbs sharply once the first hard freeze hits, so ordering early in the fall locks in both your load and your delivery window.
